{{Quote|You are a weak, pathetic rodent, and even a lunatic like Spindrall can see this.|Overseer Harkun, to Kory|<ref name="Of Mind and Matter" />}}
'''Kory''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the era of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She hailed from [[Seat of The Empire|Sith space]] and was of low [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]], but was inducted into the [[Sith/Legends|Sith Order]] due to her [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], she and five other [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolytes]] were summoned to the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] to participate in [[Sith training|trials and evaluations]] and to ultimately become the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Zash|Zash]]. Kory's trials were supervised by the vindictive [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] [[Harkun]], who first tasked the acolytes with journeying into the [[Tomb of Ajunta Pall|tomb]] of the ancient [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Ajunta Pall]], where they would find the hermit Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Spindrall]] and be judged by him. Kory completed the task and survived Spindrall's tests, but was judged by the elder Sith to be unworthy of training in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. As such, Harkun [[Death/Legends|executed]] Kory upon her return to him, ending the young acolyte's short career.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Lord Zash has tasked me with sorting through you refuse to find one worthy of being her apprentice, and I intend to do just that.|Harkun, to Kory and her peers|<ref name="Of Mind and Matter" />}}
Kory was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] alive during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|turbulent period]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] peace between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as established by the [[Treaty of Coruscant]].<ref name="Cold War">{{TORcite|All character class stories begin during the Cold War.}}</ref> She hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of the Sith imperium<ref name="ImperialAccent">{{TORcite|Multiple references throughout the game indicate that individuals from Imperial space speak with English accents, while Republic characters are largely given American accents. Kory speaks with a notable English accent.}}</ref> but was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] into a low social class. As an Imperial citizen of low birth, Kory was relegated to the status of [[Slavery/Legends|slave]], but she was eventually found to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and so was inducted into the [[Sith/Legends|Sith Order]],<ref name="Of Mind and Matter" /> per [[Force-sensitive training mandate|Imperial law]].<ref name="Secret of Cave 52">{{TORcite|type=faction|Empire|The Secret of Cave 52|Balmorra}}</ref> The young woman began her [[Sith training|training]] as a lowly [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolyte]],<ref name="Of Mind and Matter" /> but around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="GameDate" /> she was summoned to the Sith holy world of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] to become a student at the legendary [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on the planet.<ref name="Of Mind and Matter" />

The young Sith was summoned to the world to participate in a series of trials designed to find an [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] for the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] known as [[Darth Zash|Zash]]. Kory and five other former slaves&mdash;[[Balek]], [[Wydr]], [[Gerr]], [[Niloc]], and a [[Darth Nox|sixth acolyte]]<ref name="Of Mind and Matter" />&mdash;were all chosen because of their humble backgrounds; Zash had [[Force vision/Legends|prophesied]] that her apprentice would be of low birth,<ref name="In the Halls of Traitors">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|In the Halls of Traitors|Dromund Kaas}}</ref> and so commanded the academy's [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] [[Harkun]] to supervise the trials of the six acolytes and weed out the weak and unfit. Harkun, a harsh and bigoted trainer, gathered the hopefuls at the [[Korriban Arrival Port]] overlooking the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]]. There, he explained that Zash's first trial for them would be to enter the [[Tomb of Ajunta Pall|tomb]] of the ancient [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Ajunta Pall]]. Within, they were to locate and be judged by the hermit Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Spindrall]], whose opinion Zash held in high regard.<ref name="Of Mind and Matter" />

[[File:Kory_killed.png|thumb|left|250px|Kory is executed by Overseer Harkun.]]
After the initiates were given their first task, Harkun singled out the sixth acolyte, who had arrived late, for harassment. Before leaving to find Spindrall, Kory offered her peer some reassuring words of encouragement. She then proceeded into the Valley of the Dark Lords and from there, into the Tomb of Ajunta Pall. Kory succeeded in finding Spindrall within the crypt's Sacrificial Chamber, where she was challenged by the elder Sith and ultimately judged as weak and unworthy. The acolyte left the tomb in order to meet up once more with her fellow students and Overseer Harkun, this [[Time/Legends|time]] within the academy itself. Harkun had received word from Spindrall regarding his judgments of the students, and decided to make an example of Kory. To that end, the overseer called Kory forward during the meeting and announced that Spindrall had declared her to be unfit. Harkun followed up by shooting Kory with a blast of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], [[Death/Legends|executing]] the young woman before her gathered peers.<ref name="Of Mind and Matter" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Watch your back, friend. And don't worry. It'll be all right. He can't kill us all.|Kory|audio=Kory-TOR.flac|<ref name="Of Mind and Matter" />}}
Kory was a [[Color/Legends|red]]-haired human with blue-green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and fair skin. She was youthful at the time of her Sith training and had a large and uneven scar on the right side of her face.<ref name="Of Mind and Matter" />

Unlike many Sith at the academy on Korriban, Kory was neither vindictive nor competitive. She readily offered encouragement and reassurance to her fellow acolyte when the student was being harassed by Harkun, despite the fact that the rest of the acolytes ran ahead to complete their first trial. Kory also failed to impress Spindrall, who evaluated his visitors on their ability to comprehend and adhere to the [[Code of the Sith/Legends|Code of the Sith]], which was based on passion and power. Her inability to embody the tenets of the code gave Harkun an excuse to murder her and use her death as an example for her peers.<ref name="Of Mind and Matter" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kory first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]]/[[LucasArts]] online [[roleplaying game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. She acts as a non-player character seen in cutscenes during the [[Sith Inquisitor]] storyline prelude mission, "Of Mind and Matter" on Korriban.<ref name="Of Mind and Matter" />
